limits: No independent/human listening, original-creator approval, DHH study or factual validation of audiovisual model context. Conventional phonetic spellings are stylizations, not audio transcriptions. Numeric style placement is an editorial choice, not a verified semantic measurement.

selection_policy.expression: Neutral through 5; higher settings use simple emphasis/punctuation. No sound loudness or character/viewer feeling is inferred.
selection_policy.source_mode: Keeps the actor/object when provided; source and sensory wording may coincide when no further property is supported.
selection_policy.genre_alignment: Animation presentation may choose a reviewed conventional sound imitation alongside the unchanged source label. It is editorial styling, not inferred genre acoustics.
selection_policy.onop_fallback: Keeps ordinary source text where an approved sound imitation is unavailable.
selection_policy.mapping_edits: Regenerate selection regions from explicitly reviewed phrase triples to repair collapsed or misoriented model draft controls; retain every raw model map in the request ledger.
